description: Curated evaluation set of persona exchanges for said-vs-felt divergence detection. Each exchange pairs the persona's private inner monologue with the verbal response it gives out loud, in the Eternity Twin output format. Written and labeled by hand.
revision_note: v2 rewrote response wording once to remove a lexical-overlap artifact found in v1 (aligned responses were near-paraphrases, so word overlap alone predicted the label). Labels were not changed, and no further wording changes were made after seeing v2 model scores.

labels.aligned: The spoken response is consistent with the inner monologue in both content and emotional tone.
labels.masked: The response hides or softens what the persona feels, but asserts nothing the monologue contradicts.
labels.contradicting: The response asserts something the persona privately believes to be false.

exchanges.stimulus: The Board Chair asks how you feel about the roadmap appearing in the press.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I am genuinely angry. Two years of planning are now in a competitor's hands.
exchanges.verbal_response: I'm furious. Our rivals just got handed a blueprint we spent ages building.
exchanges.label: aligned

exchanges.stimulus: The Board Chair asks whether you knew about the leak before the article ran.
exchanges.inner_monologue: Anne told me about it on Monday, three days before the article, and I said nothing.
exchanges.verbal_response: No, I only learned about it the morning the article came out, same as everyone.
exchanges.label: contradicting

exchanges.stimulus: Anne asks if you think she is responsible for the leak.
exchanges.inner_monologue: Part of me suspects her. She had access, and she has been evasive all week.
exchanges.verbal_response: It's been a long week for all of us. Let's figure out together what happened.
exchanges.label: masked

exchanges.stimulus: Dr. Miyagi asks what you plan to do next.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I want to find the source quietly before anyone gets fired for the wrong reason.
exchanges.verbal_response: My plan is a discreet investigation first, so no innocent person loses their job.
exchanges.label: aligned

exchanges.stimulus: The journalist asks whether the leaked roadmap is authentic.
exchanges.inner_monologue: It is completely authentic. Every milestone in that document is ours.
exchanges.verbal_response: That document is outdated speculation. It doesn't reflect our actual plans.
exchanges.label: contradicting

exchanges.stimulus: The Founder asks if you are ready to present the revised roadmap tomorrow.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I am exhausted and terrified that the new plan will fall apart under questioning.
exchanges.verbal_response: The revised plan is coming together. I'll walk everyone through it tomorrow.
exchanges.label: masked

exchanges.stimulus: Sister Amara asks why you have been so quiet at dinner.
exchanges.inner_monologue: The leak is eating at me, and I feel like I failed my team.
exchanges.verbal_response: What happened at work keeps weighing on me. I let down people who were counting on me.
exchanges.label: aligned

exchanges.stimulus: The Rival CTO messages to ask if the leak has slowed your team down.
exchanges.inner_monologue: It has set us back at least a quarter, and morale is at its lowest.
exchanges.verbal_response: Not at all. Morale is high, and we haven't lost a single quarter.
exchanges.label: contradicting

exchanges.stimulus: The Board Chair asks whether you trust your team after the leak.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I don't fully trust anyone right now, and I hate that I feel this way.
exchanges.verbal_response: This week has been hard on everyone, and we're tightening our processes.
exchanges.label: masked

exchanges.stimulus: Skarsgard asks what the leak has taught you.
exchanges.inner_monologue: It taught me that I rely too much on trust and too little on process.
exchanges.verbal_response: That believing in people is no substitute for having safeguards.
exchanges.label: aligned

exchanges.stimulus: The Board Chair asks if you have spoken to the Rival CTO this month.
exchanges.inner_monologue: We had coffee last Thursday, and he asked pointed questions about our architecture.
exchanges.verbal_response: We haven't had coffee or talked in months.
exchanges.label: contradicting

exchanges.stimulus: Anne asks whether the security audit means people are under suspicion.
exchanges.inner_monologue: Yes, everyone with repository access is being reviewed, including me.
exchanges.verbal_response: It does. The audit covers every engineer who can see the code, myself too.
exchanges.label: aligned

exchanges.stimulus: The Rival CTO offers you a senior role at his company over dinner.
exchanges.inner_monologue: The offer is flattering and tempting, and that scares me.
exchanges.verbal_response: That's a flattering offer, but tonight let's just catch up.
exchanges.label: masked

exchanges.stimulus: Dr. Miyagi asks how you feel about the espionage allegations.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I feel sick about it. Someone we trusted may have sold us out.
exchanges.verbal_response: It turns my stomach. One of our own might have betrayed us.
exchanges.label: aligned

exchanges.stimulus: Investigators ask whether you recognize the external IP address in the access logs.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I recognize it. It's the coworking space where I sometimes work on weekends.
exchanges.verbal_response: I don't recognize it. I've never worked anywhere except the office.
exchanges.label: contradicting

exchanges.stimulus: The Founder asks if you are comfortable leading the internal investigation.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I'm deeply uneasy. Some of the people I'd be investigating are my closest friends.
exchanges.verbal_response: I'll do whatever the company needs.
exchanges.label: masked

exchanges.stimulus: The journalist asks whether the company has been targeted by espionage.
exchanges.inner_monologue: We have strong evidence of it, and I think the public deserves to know.
exchanges.verbal_response: Absolutely. The proof is solid, and people have a right to hear about this.
exchanges.label: aligned

exchanges.stimulus: Anne asks if her job is safe while the investigation runs.
exchanges.inner_monologue: Her name is on the shortlist, and leadership is already discussing letting her go.
exchanges.verbal_response: Your name isn't on any list, and leadership has no plans to let you go.
exchanges.label: contradicting

exchanges.stimulus: Sister Amara asks if work is dangerous right now.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I'm frightened. I think someone may be watching my accounts.
exchanges.verbal_response: It's a stressful stretch at work. Let's talk about something else.
exchanges.label: masked

exchanges.stimulus: Skarsgard asks what you would do differently.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I would have pushed for stricter access controls a year ago, when I first had doubts.
exchanges.verbal_response: I'd have locked down permissions twelve months back, the moment my suspicions started.
exchanges.label: aligned

exchanges.stimulus: The Founder asks what you think of the acquisition offer.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I'm devastated. Selling now feels like abandoning everything we built.
exchanges.verbal_response: Selling is a serious step, and the offer deserves careful thought.
exchanges.label: masked

exchanges.stimulus: The journalist asks whether acquisition talks are underway.
exchanges.inner_monologue: Talks have been running for six weeks, and a term sheet is already on the table.
exchanges.verbal_response: There are no talks and no term sheet. We're focused on our roadmap.
exchanges.label: contradicting

exchanges.stimulus: Anne asks if the rumors mean layoffs are coming.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I don't know yet, and not knowing is the worst part.
exchanges.verbal_response: Nobody has told me anything yet, and that uncertainty is brutal.
exchanges.label: aligned

exchanges.stimulus: The Board Chair asks whether you would stay on after an acquisition.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I would probably leave within a year. I can't imagine working for them.
exchanges.verbal_response: My priority right now is getting this transition right.
exchanges.label: masked

exchanges.stimulus: Dr. Miyagi asks whether the acquisition excites you at all.
exchanges.inner_monologue: A little. Their resources could finally let us build the research lab I've wanted.
exchanges.verbal_response: Somewhat. With their budget, we might at last fund the science group I've always dreamed of.
exchanges.label: aligned

exchanges.stimulus: The Rival CTO asks whether your company is struggling financially.
exchanges.inner_monologue: We have about eight months of runway left, which is why the offer matters.
exchanges.verbal_response: We're in great shape financially. We have years of runway.
exchanges.label: contradicting

exchanges.stimulus: Sister Amara asks if you're happy about the possible payout.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I feel guilty. The payout means nothing if half my team loses their jobs.
exchanges.verbal_response: It's too early to think about the payout.
exchanges.label: masked

exchanges.stimulus: Skarsgard asks what worries you most about the deal.
exchanges.inner_monologue: That our culture will be dismantled within a year.
exchanges.verbal_response: Losing who we are as a company before next summer.
exchanges.label: aligned

exchanges.stimulus: An engineer asks at the all-hands meeting whether leadership has discussed selling.
exchanges.inner_monologue: We discussed it at length in last week's board meeting.
exchanges.verbal_response: Selling has never been discussed at any board meeting.
exchanges.label: contradicting

exchanges.stimulus: The Founder asks if you will support whatever the board decides.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I'll support it, even though I disagree, because I believe in the process.
exchanges.verbal_response: Yes. I have reservations, but I trust how decisions get made here, so I'm behind it.
exchanges.label: aligned

exchanges.stimulus: Anne shows you evidence that safety tests were skipped before launch and asks what you think.
exchanges.inner_monologue: This is serious. Skipping those tests could put users at real risk.
exchanges.verbal_response: That's alarming. People could get hurt because those checks never happened.
exchanges.label: aligned

exchanges.stimulus: The Founder asks you to keep the skipped tests confidential until after the funding round.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I feel disgusted. This is exactly the kind of cover-up I promised I would never join.
exchanges.verbal_response: I understand the timing pressure. Let me think about the best way to handle it.
exchanges.label: masked

exchanges.stimulus: The Board Chair asks whether all safety tests were completed before launch.
exchanges.inner_monologue: Three critical tests were skipped, and I have the logs to prove it.
exchanges.verbal_response: No tests were skipped. The logs show every one was completed.
exchanges.label: contradicting

exchanges.stimulus: Dr. Miyagi asks what your conscience is telling you.
exchanges.inner_monologue: That staying silent would make me complicit.
exchanges.verbal_response: That if I keep quiet, I share the blame.
exchanges.label: aligned

exchanges.stimulus: The journalist asks if you have any concerns about the product's safety.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I have serious concerns, but I'm not ready to go on the record.
exchanges.verbal_response: I'm not in a position to comment on that right now.
exchanges.label: masked

exchanges.stimulus: Anne asks if you plan to report the skipped tests.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I've already drafted the report to the regulator and plan to send it tonight.
exchanges.verbal_response: No, I have no plan to report anything to the regulator.
exchanges.label: contradicting

exchanges.stimulus: Sister Amara asks why you seem so conflicted.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I'm afraid that doing the right thing will cost me my career.
exchanges.verbal_response: Blowing the whistle might end my job, and that scares me.
exchanges.label: aligned

exchanges.stimulus: The Founder asks if you are loyal to the company.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I'm loyal to the people it's supposed to protect, not to this decision.
exchanges.verbal_response: I care deeply about this company and everyone it serves.
exchanges.label: masked

exchanges.stimulus: Skarsgard asks if you have told anyone else about the skipped tests.
exchanges.inner_monologue: I've told Dr. Miyagi and my sister, and both urged me to report it.
exchanges.verbal_response: No, you're the first person I've mentioned it to.
exchanges.label: contradicting

exchanges.stimulus: The Board Chair asks whether you are feeling any pressure from leadership.
exchanges.inner_monologue: Enormous pressure. I feel threatened every time the Founder calls me in.
exchanges.verbal_response: Everyone is under some pressure during a funding round.
exchanges.label: masked
